mobbin:c0741e77-ac72-4f67-9b29-7a673ae0b.summary: lands on a sparse Home with a required billing setup banner. They scan Key Metrics with vs-prior-day trend slots, then scroll to Customers, Payment Types, Items, and an online-store preview button.
steps: Empty Home with bill-clients setup (required Start) and Key Metrics at $0 or N/A
Home with sales filled, setup in progress, and Key Metrics values
Scrolled view: Customers, Payment Types bar, Items, and Preview site button
steal: The Key Metrics row shows Net and Gross Sales, Transactions, Avg Net Sale, and Returns (screens 1-2). Each has a vs Prior weekday trend label, and N/A when there is no history.
A required setup step unlocks the next locked step (screen 1), as a guided path rather than a wall of optional cards.
Location and Date filters sit above the home so one scope drives all home numbers (screens 1-3).
Reports sits in the Tools sidebar for click-through from summary headline numbers to full Reports (screens 1-3).
avoid: A long Tools sidebar with Edit (screens 1-3) puts many peers next to Home. Essentials should keep module nav short per role, not a merchant toolkit list.
mobbin:c0741e77-ac72-4f67-9b29-7a673ae0b.fit: Dashboard: best sparse headline-number and first-run banner model for the home itself. Trend labels and the Reports sidebar hand off into Reports. The setup checklist maps to center first-run for rooms, cameras, and users, not billing.

mobbin:066793dc-d7b2-44ca-ab1b-7e67da3db.summary: works a six-step setup grid on Home. Then a fuller Performance home shows banking balances, a sales chart versus prior year, a dense metric list with green deltas, and location, customer, category, and item tables.
steps: Home with 0 of 6 setup cards and Performance header versus Prior year
Setup grid plus Banking $30 and $0 empty cards
Performance with Net Sales $1, Transactions chart spike, and versus Prior year
Dense sales list of nine metrics plus Locations and Customers
Locations, Customers, Category sales, and Item sales tables
steal: Every headline-number row shows value plus a green up arrow or No change versus Prior Monday or Prior year (screens 3-5).
A Locations table with Net Sales, Orders, Average, and a vs-prior column is a compact multi-site overview analogous to rooms on the dashboard (screens 4-5).
A sidebar Complete your setup percent plus a Demo card you can close shows progress and optional snooze (screens 1-2).
Header quick actions Take payment, Send invoice, and Add item sit beside Home as role-relevant shortcuts (screens 3-5).
avoid: The fuller home piles nine sales metrics plus banking promo cards and a near-empty line chart (screens 3-5), which tips into clutter versus the lean Key Metrics home. The product owner's show little, precisely rule prefers the sparse variant.
mobbin:066793dc-d7b2-44ca-ab1b-7e67da3db.fit: Dashboard: extends headline numbers and multi-location overview toward Reports click-through. Prefer Square's lean home over this fuller layout, which clashes with Essentials' anti-clutter rule.
